title: lupinus pilosus subsp. luthereaui
intro: Lupinus pilosus subsp. luthereaui, commonly known as Luthereau's lupine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. Research suggests that the plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Luthereau's lupine are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and glycosides, which have been reported to exhibit anti-cancer, antimicrobial, and neuroprotective properties. However, more studies are needed to confirm the full extent of its medicinal potential and to fully understand its effects on human health.
